about: Fight mode's new lines to record with ElevenLabs (eleven_v3: [tags] are performance directions, not words): the regulars who fight you, the regulars watching, your crew, your own voice, the slap reactions, and fight mode's own original announcer. Each take goes to public/voices/<voice>/<id>.mp3 and into public/voices/index.json (tools/voices/render_eleven.py does both; scripts/voice-lines.ts lists these in tools/voices/eleven-lines.json). The game picks a take up as soon as it is in the index; until then these lines are captions with wordless effort sounds (fighters) or synthesized stings (the announcer), never browser TTS.
